description.value: City Avenue Market is a family-owned grocery chain founded in Vancouver in 1986, with its New Westminster location established in 2010 on the scenic Quayside Drive waterfront along the Fraser River. It emphasizes fresh local and organic produce alongside a broad selection of groceries, bulk items, dairy, meat, baked goods, and a newly added deli offering freshly sliced meats and cheeses. The store is wheelchair accessible and also offers online ordering with Greater Vancouver delivery.
